source: i want to create a game with amazing physics and Bikes I want it to be like the game mx bikes I want free style tricks custom building and good bike brands such as KTM. surron Suzuki stark future Yamaha Honda gas gas and beta I want a 3d game with big free style ramps and I want to have play time rewards and I want to ride to make money and get bonus money for doing tricks such as whips superman seat grabs normal super man and more

image_prompt.text: Big freestyle ramps, kickers, jumps and rails whose physics reactions are the entertainment, arranged so a rider can link them into a continuous line
Dynamic environmental hazards layered over the shared riding ground
Ridable routes chaining the freestyle zones together across the terrain
a large open outdoor terrain of dirt, packed tracks and open ground to ride between the ramp setups

layout_placement.text: buildable ground where players place their own ramps and structures

notes: Racing was ruled out by its own boundary rule: there is no lap and no finish line here, only freestyle riding, which the genre notes send to Simulation
Physics Sim was taken over Vehicle Sim because physics-rig is the only option in the network that describes a ramp, and the prompt leads with physics and freestyle ramps
hazard-kill comes with the preset and has nothing in the prompt to attach to
Custom building has no option row in Simulation - buildable ground only exists as a shape (plot-isolated / plot-shared), which would have replaced the shared world

open_questions.ask: What should the riding grounds look like - a desert freestyle compound, green hills, an industrial skatepark?
Should players build ramps anywhere in the world, or on a set-aside plot?
How large should the terrain be - one big freestyle compound, or an open world you ride between spots in?
Where do players pick a bike - a garage in the world, or a menu?

coverage_missing.ask: What environment should the riding grounds be set in?
Free placement anywhere, or a dedicated build plot?
One compound or an open world?
How big are the big ramps - what gap should a rider be able to clear?

answers.ask: What should the riding grounds look like - a desert freestyle compound, green hills, an industrial skatepark?
answers.answer: Make it a desert freestyle compound with dirt tracks, large ramps, and open riding space, matching an MX Bikes-style motocross game.

answers.ask: Should players build ramps anywhere in the world, or on a set-aside plot?
answers.answer: Use a set-aside build plot so players can make custom ramps without cluttering the main riding compound.

answers.ask: How large should the terrain be - one big freestyle compound, or an open world you ride between spots in?
answers.answer: Start with one big freestyle compound rather than a larger open world, with enough room for tracks, ramps, and the building plot.

answers.ask: Where do players pick a bike - a garage in the world, or a menu?
answers.answer: Players should pick and customize their bikes from a garage in the world.
